title: krynitzkia diffusa
intro: Krynitzkia diffusa, commonly known as the bitter apple, is a plant species within the borage family (Boraginaceae). The plant is reported to have various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and indigestion. Studies have found that Krynitzkia diffusa exhibits therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
